paper_title: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Liquid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
coupling_convention: g_ap gradient coupling in GeV^-1 (g_aNN, not the dimensionless g_ap)
notes: CASPEr-Gradient Low-Field NMR search for ALP-proton gradient coupling. No detection; upper limit |g_ap| <= 3e-2 GeV^-1 (95% CL) over the narrow mass range 5.576741-5.577733 neV/c^2 (240 Hz window at 1.348570 MHz). Coupling reported as gradient coupling g_aNN in GeV^-1 (dimension of inverse energy), NOT the standard dimensionless g_ap; downstream conversion (g_ap_dimensionless ~ 2 m_p * g_aNN) may be needed. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Thermally polarized methanol proton sample; proof-of-principle commissioning measurement. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 2))
